exercises.title: Exercise 5: The Time Machine
exercises.instruction: The Time Machine: Ein verrückter Trip durch die Zeiten! Setze die Verben in der richtigen Form ein (Type 0, 1, 2 oder 3).
exercises.text: Last week, Bob found a time machine in his basement. He pressed a button by accident. If he {{0}} the red button, he wouldn't have travelled to the past! Now he is stuck in the Jurassic period millions of years ago. He thinks: 'If I {{1}} my smartphone, I would take a picture of that dinosaur.' But it's a known fact: If you travel in time, you usually {{2}} all your modern gadgets. Suddenly, the T-Rex looks at him. 'Oh no! If the dinosaur {{3}} me moving, it will eat me!' Bob whispers. He quickly presses the return button on the machine. 'If I {{4}} you, I would run really fast,' a robotic voice from the machine says. Bob jumps through the portal just in time. Back in his basement, he breathes heavily. 'Wow! If I hadn't run fast enough, I {{5}} there.' He locks the door. 'I promise: I {{6}} that machine again if I enter the basement tomorrow.'
